Grammar · Level 2 · Stative and Action Verbs

Stative or Action?

One verb, two meanings: look at the pictures

state = no -ing · action = -ing OK
 

The idea

Action or State?

Action

Something you DO.

Right now: am / is / are + verb-ing

Right now, the kids are swimming.

State

Owning, knowing, an opinion, a sense, or how something is.

Right now: simple present, no -ing

Right now, I understand the lesson.

Careful: some verbs can be a state OR an action. The meaning decides. Look at the next 8 pairs.
 

Two meanings · 1 of 8

have

State · no -ing

My uncle has a shiny red truck.

have = own

Action · -ing OK

Lily is having a birthday party.

have = eat, a party, a good time

 

Two meanings · 2 of 8

think

State · no -ing

I think it is going to rain.

think = an opinion

Action · -ing OK

Ben is thinking about what to eat.

think = use your mind

 

Two meanings · 3 of 8

taste

State · no -ing

Lemons taste sour.

taste = the flavor

Action · -ing OK

The baby is tasting a lemon.

taste = put food in your mouth to try it

 

Two meanings · 4 of 8

smell

State · no -ing

This popcorn smells great!

smell = the smell of something

Action · -ing OK

Dan is smelling his towel. Is it clean?

smell = use your nose to check

 

Two meanings · 5 of 8

see

State · no -ing

Wow! I see a rainbow!

see = notice with your eyes

Action · -ing OK

Nina and Carlos are seeing each other.

see = date someone

 

Two meanings · 6 of 8

look

State · no -ing

Jake looks tired.

look = seem

Action · -ing OK

Mei is looking at a map.

look = use your eyes on purpose

 

Two meanings · 7 of 8

feel

State · no -ing

Ice feels cold.

feel = how it is when you touch it

Action · -ing OK

My mom is feeling the avocados.

feel = touch it to check

 

Two meanings · 8 of 8

weigh

State · no -ing

This watermelon weighs 20 pounds.

weigh = how heavy it is

Action · -ing OK

The man is weighing the apples.

weigh = put it on a scale

 

Practice · 1–2

State or Action?

Click a, b, c, or d.

1. Mmm! This coffee ____ really good.

2. Look! The kids ____ a lot of fun in the pool.

 

Practice · 3–4

State or Action?

Click a, b, c, or d.

3. My boss ____ my idea is great.

4. Right now, Paul ____ the cookie dough.

 

Practice · 5–6

State or Action?

Click a, b, c, or d.

5. Excuse me. I ____ for the bathroom.

6. Be careful! The floor ____ wet.

 

Practice · 7–8

State or Action?

Click a, b, c, or d.

7. At the moment, the nurse ____ my baby.

8. Oh no! I ____ a big spider on the wall!
